description:
Cast Ornithopter.
Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ornithopter.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Ornithopter dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {2}.
Together Forever triggers, returning Ornithopter to your hand.
Repeat.
